messages.subject: About nimble error
parts:
Hi everybody,

I am trying to use nimble to fit Bayesian Occupancy Model and when I try to view the mcmcplots, I get error message "

Plots for beta01

beta01. Error in bw.SJ(x, method = "ste"): sample is too sparse to find TD

Plots for beta03

beta03. Error in bw.SJ(x, method = "ste"): sample is too sparse to find TD

Plots for beta04

beta04. Error in bw.SJ(x, method = "ste"): sample is too sparse to find TD

Plots for beta05

beta05. Error in bw.SJ(x, method = "ste"): sample is too sparse to find TD"


Did anyone meet that kind of error before? Can anybody help me about that?


Thank you so much

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: About nimble error
parts:
The error seems to be coming from bandwidth selection of kernel smoothing in mcmcplots, which is not part of nimble.  It may be that the posterior is not mixed or has some other problem.  Can you look at the posterior sample directly and provide more information about the model?

-Perry
